# This is not every fail site in the chart: the validation helpers carry ~55
# `fail` calls and only the cases below are pinned. When you add or change a
# fail site in _helpers-validation.tpl or logfire-validate-config.yaml, add a
# case here.
release:
  name: lf
  namespace: default
set:
  adminEmail: test@example.com
  objectStore:
    uri: s3://test-bucket
  dev:
    deployPostgres: true
tests:
  - it: rejects extra exporters that replace the backend exporter
    set:
      otel_collector.extraExporters:
        otlp_http:
          endpoint: https://elsewhere.example.com
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'extraExporters cannot replace chart-owned component "otlp_http"'

  - it: rejects extra processors that replace the memory limiter
    set:
      otel_collector.extraProcessors:
        memory_limiter:
          limit_mib: 1
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'extraProcessors cannot replace chart-owned component "memory_limiter"'

  - it: rejects extra pipelines that replace backend metrics
    set:
      otel_collector.extraPipelines:
        metrics:
          exporters: [debug]
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'extraPipelines cannot replace chart-owned component "metrics"'

  - it: reserves the Prometheus pipeline even while disabled
    set:
      otel_collector.extraPipelines:
        metrics/prometheus:
          exporters: [debug]
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'extraPipelines cannot replace chart-owned component "metrics/prometheus"'

  - it: rejects an exporter list
    set:
      otel_collector.extraExporters: [googlecloud]
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'extraExporters must be a map'

  - it: reserves the collector self-metric pipeline
    set:
      otel_collector.extraPipelines:
        metrics/self:
          exporters: [debug]
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'extraPipelines cannot replace chart-owned component "metrics/self"'

  - it: reserves the collector self-metric identity processor
    set:
      otel_collector.extraProcessors:
        resource/self:
          attributes: []
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'extraProcessors cannot replace chart-owned component "resource/self"'

  - it: preserves custom self-metric components when built-in forwarding is disabled
    set:
      otel_collector.selfMetrics.enabled: false
      otel_collector.extraProcessors:
        resource/self:
          attributes: []
      otel_collector.extraPipelines:
        metrics/self:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [resource/self]
          exporters: [otlp_http]
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-otel-collector-cfg.yaml
    asserts:
      - notFailedTemplate: {}

  - it: rejects a processor list
    set:
      otel_collector.extraProcessors: [resourcedetection]
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'extraProcessors must be a map'

  - it: rejects a pipeline list
    set:
      otel_collector.extraPipelines: [metrics/gcp]
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'extraPipelines must be a map'

  - it: existingSecret.enabled=true with empty name fails validation
    set:
      existingSecret:
        enabled: true
        name: ""
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "existingSecret.name is required when existingSecret.enabled is true. Provide the name of your Kubernetes Secret containing logfire-dex-client-secret, logfire-encryption-key, logfire-meta-write-token, logfire-meta-frontend-token, logfire-jwt-secret and logfire-unsubscribe-secret keys."

  - it: rejects empty template result in production
    set:
      objectStore:
        uri: '{{ "" }}'
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.uri is required. Set objectStore.uri to your S3/Azure/GCS bucket URI (e.g., 's3://bucket-name' or 'az://container-name'). For local development, you can set dev.deployRustfs=true instead."

  - it: rejects missing value template result in production
    set:
      objectStore:
        uri: '{{ .Values.missingBucket | default "" }}'
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.uri is required. Set objectStore.uri to your S3/Azure/GCS bucket URI (e.g., 's3://bucket-name' or 'az://container-name'). For local development, you can set dev.deployRustfs=true instead."

  - it: rejects whitespace template result in production
    set:
      objectStore:
        uri: '{{ "   " }}'
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.uri is required. Set objectStore.uri to your S3/Azure/GCS bucket URI (e.g., 's3://bucket-name' or 'az://container-name'). For local development, you can set dev.deployRustfs=true instead."

  - it: rejects whitespace literal in production
    set:
      objectStore:
        uri: "   "
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.uri is required. Set objectStore.uri to your S3/Azure/GCS bucket URI (e.g., 's3://bucket-name' or 'az://container-name'). For local development, you can set dev.deployRustfs=true instead."

  - it: rejects empty literal in production
    set:
      objectStore:
        uri: ''
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.uri is required. Set objectStore.uri to your S3/Azure/GCS bucket URI (e.g., 's3://bucket-name' or 'az://container-name'). For local development, you can set dev.deployRustfs=true instead."

  - it: defaults an empty template result to the in-cluster bucket with development RustFS
    set:
      dev:
        deployRustfs: true
      objectStore:
        uri: '{{ "" }}'
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
      - templates/logfire-ff-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: data.FF_OBJECT_STORE_URI
          value: s3://logfire
        documentSelector:
          path: metadata.name
          value: logfire-ff-base-config
        template: templates/logfire-ff-config.yaml

  - it: rejects an objectStore.volumes entry named tmp
    set:
      objectStore:
        volumes:
          - name: tmp
            emptyDir: {}
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.volumes[0].name 'tmp' is reserved by the chart. Rename the volume, because chart-owned containers mount a volume with that name. Reserved names: tmp, scratch-data, ingest-data, logfire-data."

  - it: rejects an objectStore.volumes entry named logfire-data
    set:
      objectStore:
        volumes:
          - name: logfire-data
            emptyDir: {}
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.volumes[0].name 'logfire-data' is reserved by the chart. Rename the volume, because chart-owned containers mount a volume with that name. Reserved names: tmp, scratch-data, ingest-data, logfire-data."

  - it: rejects an objectStore.volumeMounts entry at /tmp
    set:
      objectStore:
        volumeMounts:
          - name: credentials
            mountPath: /tmp
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.volumeMounts[0].mountPath '/tmp' is reserved by the chart. Use another mount path, because chart-owned containers mount a writable volume at that path. Reserved paths: /tmp, /scratch, /fusionfire/ingest-data, /var/lib/logfire."

  - it: rejects an objectStore.volumeMounts entry at /var/lib/logfire
    set:
      objectStore:
        volumeMounts:
          - name: credentials
            mountPath: /var/lib/logfire
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.volumeMounts[0].mountPath '/var/lib/logfire' is reserved by the chart. Use another mount path, because chart-owned containers mount a writable volume at that path. Reserved paths: /tmp, /scratch, /fusionfire/ingest-data, /var/lib/logfire."

  - it: accepts objectStore volumes and mounts outside the reserved names and paths
    set:
      objectStore:
        volumes:
          - name: credentials
            secret:
              secretName: object-store-credentials
        volumeMounts:
          - name: credentials
            mountPath: /etc/object-store
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - notFailedTemplate: {}

  - it: rejects an objectStore.volumes entry that collides with an in-cluster TLS volume
    set:
      inClusterTls:
        enabled: true
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: logfire-incluster-ca
      objectStore:
        volumes:
          - name: logfire-incluster-tls
            emptyDir: {}
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.volumes[0].name 'logfire-incluster-tls' is reserved by the chart. Rename the volume, because chart-owned containers mount a volume with that name. Reserved names: tmp, scratch-data, ingest-data, logfire-data, logfire-incluster-tls, logfire-incluster-ca-bundle."

  - it: rejects an objectStore.volumeMounts entry that collides with an in-cluster TLS mount
    set:
      inClusterTls:
        enabled: true
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: logfire-incluster-ca
      objectStore:
        volumeMounts:
          - name: credentials
            mountPath: /etc/logfire/incluster-ca
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.volumeMounts[0].mountPath '/etc/logfire/incluster-ca' is reserved by the chart. Use another mount path, because chart-owned containers mount a writable volume at that path. Reserved paths: /tmp, /scratch, /fusionfire/ingest-data, /var/lib/logfire, /etc/tls, /etc/logfire/incluster-ca."

  - it: accepts in-cluster TLS volume names when in-cluster TLS is disabled
    set:
      objectStore:
        volumes:
          - name: logfire-incluster-tls
            emptyDir: {}
        volumeMounts:
          - name: logfire-incluster-tls
            mountPath: /etc/tls
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - notFailedTemplate: {}

  - it: rejects an objectStore.volumeMounts entry that collides with the SMTP CA bundle mount
    set:
      smtp:
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: logfire-smtp-ca
      objectStore:
        volumeMounts:
          - name: credentials
            mountPath: /etc/logfire/smtp-ca
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "objectStore.volumeMounts[0].mountPath '/etc/logfire/smtp-ca' is reserved by the chart. Use another mount path, because chart-owned containers mount a writable volume at that path. Reserved paths: /tmp, /scratch, /fusionfire/ingest-data, /var/lib/logfire, /etc/logfire/smtp-ca."

  - it: accepts the SMTP CA bundle mount path while no CA bundle is configured
    set:
      objectStore:
        volumeMounts:
          - name: credentials
            mountPath: /etc/logfire/smtp-ca
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - notFailedTemplate: {}

  - it: unknown preset name fails the install
    set:
      sizingPreset: not-a-real-preset
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: 'Unknown sizingPreset "not-a-real-preset". Valid presets: dev, large, small, standard, tiny'

  - it: rejects scratch volume quantities below 1Mi
    set:
      logfire-ff-compaction-worker:
        scratchVolume:
          storage: 512Ki
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-ff-compaction-worker.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'scratchVolume.storage "512Ki" is below the 1Mi minimum'

  - it: requires a multi-region location for Gemini 3.5
    set:
      ai:
        model: google-cloud:gemini-3.5-flash
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "ai.vertexAi.multiRegionLocation is required when ai.model contains Google Cloud model 'google-cloud:gemini-3.5-flash'. Set it to 'us' or 'eu'."

  - it: requires a region for a regional fallback
    set:
      ai:
        reasoningModel: "google-cloud:gemini-3.5-flash, google-cloud:gemini-2.5-flash"
        vertexAi:
          multiRegionLocation: eu
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorMessage: "ai.vertexAi.region is required when ai.reasoningModel contains regional Google Cloud model 'google-cloud:gemini-2.5-flash'."

  - it: accepts a mixed fallback chain when both locations are configured
    set:
      ai:
        model: "google-cloud:gemini-3.5-flash,google-cloud:gemini-2.5-flash"
        vertexAi:
          region: europe-west4
          multiRegionLocation: eu
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - hasDocuments:
          count: 0

  # --- AI provider config ---
  - it: rejects a multi-region location outside us/eu
    set:
      ai:
        vertexAi:
          multiRegionLocation: global
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: "multiRegionLocation must be exactly 'us' or 'eu'"

  - it: requires an OpenAI API key for OpenAI models
    set:
      ai:
        model: openai:gpt-4o
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.openAi\.apiKey is required'

  - it: requires an OpenAI API key for a secondary fallback
    set:
      ai:
        chatModel: "google-cloud:gemini-3.5-flash, openai-chat:gpt-4o"
        vertexAi:
          multiRegionLocation: eu
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.openAi\.apiKey is required when ai\.chatModel uses OpenAI model'

  - it: requires the Azure endpoint for a secondary fallback
    set:
      ai:
        model: "openai:gpt-4o, azure:gpt-4o"
        openAi:
          apiKey: test
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.azureOpenAi\.endpoint is required'

  - it: requires the Azure API key for a secondary fallback
    set:
      ai:
        model: "openai:gpt-4o, azure:gpt-4o"
        openAi:
          apiKey: test
        azureOpenAi:
          endpoint: https://example.openai.azure.com
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.azureOpenAi\.apiKey is required'

  - it: requires a region for a secondary Google Vertex fallback
    set:
      ai:
        reasoningModel: "openai:gpt-4o, google-vertex:gemini-2.5-flash"
        openAi:
          apiKey: test
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.vertexAi\.region is required'

  - it: requires a project id for a secondary Anthropic Vertex fallback
    set:
      ai:
        llmJudgeModel: "openai:gpt-4o, anthropic-vertex:claude-sonnet-4"
        openAi:
          apiKey: test
        vertexAi:
          region: europe-west4
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.vertexAi\.anthropicProjectId is required'

  - it: accepts a cross-provider fallback chain with provider configuration
    set:
      ai:
        model: "openai:gpt-4o, azure:gpt-4o, google-vertex:gemini-2.5-flash, anthropic-vertex:claude-sonnet-4"
        openAi:
          apiKey: test
        azureOpenAi:
          endpoint: https://example.openai.azure.com
          apiKey: test
        vertexAi:
          region: europe-west4
          anthropicProjectId: test-project
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - notFailedTemplate: {}

  - it: requires the Azure OpenAI endpoint
    set:
      ai:
        model: azure:gpt-4o
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.azureOpenAi\.endpoint is required'

  - it: requires the Azure OpenAI API key
    set:
      ai:
        model: azure:gpt-4o
        azureOpenAi:
          endpoint: https://example.openai.azure.com
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.azureOpenAi\.apiKey is required'

  - it: requires a region for Google Vertex AI models
    set:
      ai:
        model: google-vertex:gemini-2.5-flash
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.vertexAi\.region is required'

  - it: requires a project id for Anthropic Vertex models
    set:
      ai:
        model: anthropic-vertex:claude-sonnet-4
        vertexAi:
          region: europe-west4
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ai\.vertexAi\.anthropicProjectId is required'

  # --- public hostnames ---
  - it: requires at least one public hostname
    set:
      ingress:
        hostnames: []
        hostname: ""
      gateway:
        hostnames: []
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'At least one hostname is required for Logfire'

  # --- postgres and dex storage ---
  - it: requires postgresSecret.name when postgresSecret is enabled
    set:
      dev:
        deployPostgres: false
      postgresSecret:
        enabled: true
        name: ""
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'postgresSecret\.name is required'

  - it: requires postgresDsn without dev postgres or a secret
    set:
      dev:
        deployPostgres: false
      postgresDsn: ""
      postgresFFDsn: ""
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'postgresDsn is required'

  - it: requires postgresFFDsn without dev postgres or a secret
    set:
      dev:
        deployPostgres: false
      postgresDsn: postgres://crud
      postgresFFDsn: ""
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'postgresFFDsn is required'

  - it: requires the Dex postgres host when Dex stores state in postgres
    set:
      dev:
        deployPostgres: false
      postgresDsn: postgres://crud
      postgresFFDsn: postgres://ff
      logfire-dex:
        config:
          storage:
            type: postgres
            config:
              host: ""
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'storage\.config\.host is required'

  # --- secrets ---
  - it: requires adminSecret.name when adminSecret is enabled
    set:
      adminSecret:
        enabled: true
        name: ""
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'adminSecret\.name is required'

  - it: requires existingGatewaySecret.name when enabled
    set:
      logfire-ai-gateway:
        enabled: true
      existingGatewaySecret:
        enabled: true
        name: ""
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'existingGatewaySecret\.name is required'

  # --- scratch volumes ---
  - it: requires scratchVolume.storage when a scratch volume is configured
    set:
      logfire-ff-query-api:
        scratchVolume:
          storageClassName: standard
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'scratchVolume\.storage is required'

  # --- removed values blocks ---
  - it: names the move when the v1 byte cache values block is still set
    set:
      logfire-ff-cache-byte:
        clientSideRouting:
          zoneAware: true
    asserts:
      # The key is ignored otherwise, so zone routing would silently turn off.
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'logfire-ff-cache-byte is no longer a values block'

  # --- autoscaling ---
  - it: rejects enabling both HPA and KEDA
    set:
      logfire-ff-ingest:
        autoscaling:
          hpa:
            enabled: true
            cpuAverage: 50
          keda:
            enabled: true
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'Both HPA and KEDA are enabled'

  - it: rejects an HPA without metrics
    set:
      sizingPreset: ""
      logfire-ff-ingest:
        autoscaling:
          hpa:
            enabled: true
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'no metrics are configured'

  - it: rejects minReplicas above maxReplicas
    set:
      logfire-ff-ingest:
        autoscaling:
          minReplicas: 5
          maxReplicas: 2
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'cannot be greater than autoscaling\.maxReplicas'

  # --- admin email ---
  - it: requires adminEmail
    set:
      adminEmail: ""
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'adminEmail is required'

  - it: rejects an invalid adminEmail
    set:
      adminEmail: not-an-email
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'does not appear to be a valid email address'

  # --- in-cluster TLS ---
  - it: rejects an unknown in-cluster TLS cert mode
    set:
      inClusterTls:
        enabled: true
        certs:
          mode: mystery
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'certs\.mode must be one of'

  - it: rejects configuring both CA bundle sources
    set:
      inClusterTls:
        enabled: true
        certs:
          mode: existingSecrets
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: ca-map
          existingSecret:
            name: ca-secret
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'specify only one'

  - it: rejects an unknown cert-manager issuer kind
    set:
      inClusterTls:
        enabled: true
        certs:
          mode: certManager
          certManager:
            issuerRef:
              kind: Weird
              name: my-issuer
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: ca-map
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'issuerRef\.kind must be'

  - it: rejects an empty issuer name with a non-namespaced issuer kind
    set:
      inClusterTls:
        enabled: true
        certs:
          mode: certManager
          certManager:
            issuerRef:
              kind: ClusterIssuer
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: ca-map
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'chart-managed \*namespaced\* Issuer'

  - it: rejects cert-manager mode without a CA bundle or chart-managed issuer
    set:
      inClusterTls:
        enabled: true
        certs:
          mode: certManager
          certManager:
            issuerRef:
              kind: Issuer
              name: my-issuer
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: ""
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'no CA bundle was provided'

  - it: requires cert-manager CRDs for certManager mode
    set:
      dev:
        deployCertManager: false
      inClusterTls:
        enabled: true
        certs:
          mode: certManager
          certManager:
            issuerRef:
              kind: Issuer
              name: my-issuer
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: ca-map
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'requires cert-manager CRDs'

  - it: rejects existingSecrets mode without a CA bundle
    set:
      inClusterTls:
        enabled: true
        certs:
          mode: existingSecrets
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: ""
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'no CA bundle was provided'

  # --- redis ---
  - it: requires redisDsn when the bundled redis is disabled
    set:
      logfire-redis:
        enabled: false
      redisDsn: ""
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'redisDsn is required'

  - it: requires redisSecret.name when the external Redis Secret is enabled
    set:
      redisSecret:
        enabled: true
        name: ""
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'redisSecret\.name is required'

  # --- gateway api ---
  - it: requires gateway.gatewayClassName when the chart creates the Gateway
    set:
      ingress:
        enabled: false
      gateway:
        enabled: true
        create: true
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'gateway\.gatewayClassName is required'

  - it: requires gateway.name when attaching to an existing Gateway
    set:
      ingress:
        enabled: false
      gateway:
        enabled: true
        create: false
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'gateway\.name is required'

  - it: rejects enabling ingress and gateway together
    set:
      ingress:
        enabled: true
      gateway:
        enabled: true
        create: true
        gatewayClassName: istio
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'Enable only one of Ingress or Gateway API'

  # --- resource quantities ---
  - it: rejects an invalid CPU quantity
    set:
      logfire-ff-ingest:
        resources:
          cpu: not-a-quantity
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'Invalid CPU format'

  - it: rejects a CPU quantity below 1m
    set:
      logfire-ff-ingest:
        resources:
          cpu: 0.5m
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'effective millicores must be >= 1m'

  - it: rejects an invalid memory quantity
    set:
      logfire-ff-ingest:
        resources:
          memory: not-a-quantity
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'Invalid quantity format'

  - it: rejects the removed ephemeralStorageRequest key
    set:
      logfire-ff-ingest:
        resources:
          ephemeralStorageRequest: 1Gi
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ephemeralStorageRequest is not supported'

  # --- pdb ---
  - it: rejects both pdb minAvailable and maxUnavailable
    set:
      logfire-backend:
        pdb:
          minAvailable: 1
          maxUnavailable: 1
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'mutually exclusive'

  # --- group organization mapping ---
  - it: rejects a group mapping without group_id
    set:
      groupOrganizationMapping:
        - organization_roles:
            - organization_name: logfire-meta
              role: admin
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'group_id. is required'

  - it: rejects a group mapping without organization_roles
    set:
      groupOrganizationMapping:
        - group_id: "38aad352-dcfb-4a08-946a-469abe30cdc4"
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'organization_roles. is required'

  - it: rejects an organization role without a role
    set:
      groupOrganizationMapping:
        - group_id: "38aad352-dcfb-4a08-946a-469abe30cdc4"
          organization_roles:
            - organization_name: logfire-meta
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'role. is required for organization'

  - it: rejects a project role without a role
    set:
      groupOrganizationMapping:
        - group_id: "38aad352-dcfb-4a08-946a-469abe30cdc4"
          organization_roles:
            - organization_name: logfire-meta
              role: admin
              project_roles:
                - project_name: some-project
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'project_roles\[0\]: .role. is required'

  # --- fusionfire query limits ---
  - it: rejects a non-positive maxQueryCostPerPod
    set:
      logfire-ff-query-api:
        maxQueryCostPerPod: 0
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'maxQueryCostPerPod must be a positive integer'

  # --- SMTP sender contract ---
  # A self-hosted install sends through its own SMTP server, so mail as pydantic.dev would fail
  # DMARC at the receiver. The platform refuses to start without a sender, and this check stops
  # the install or upgrade before any workload rolls out.
  - it: an SMTP server without a sender fails before anything rolls out
    set:
      smtp:
        host: smtp.example.com
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: "smtp.fromAddress is required when smtp.host is set"

  # The platform refuses a pydantic.dev sender on a self-hosted install. This check says so
  # before any workload rolls out.
  - it: a pydantic.dev sender fails before anything rolls out
    set:
      smtp:
        host: smtp.example.com
        fromAddress: No-Reply@Alerts.Pydantic.Dev
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: "smtp.fromAddress must not be a pydantic.dev address"

  - it: an SMTP CA bundle from both a ConfigMap and a Secret fails
    set:
      smtp:
        host: smtp.example.com
        fromAddress: logfire@example.com
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: smtp-ca
          existingSecret:
            name: smtp-ca
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: "smtp.caBundle: specify only one of existingConfigMap.name or existingSecret.name"

  # A bundle with verification off would be silently ignored, so the install fails instead.
  - it: an SMTP CA bundle with certificate verification off fails
    set:
      smtp:
        host: smtp.example.com
        fromAddress: logfire@example.com
        validate_certs: false
        caBundle:
          existingConfigMap:
            name: smtp-ca
    templates:
      - templates/logfire-validate-config.yaml
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: "smtp.caBundle is set but smtp.validate_certs is false"

  # --- otel collector queue and storage budgets ---
  - it: rejects a self-metrics port equal to the Prometheus exporter port
    set:
      otel_collector.prometheus.enabled: true
      otel_collector.prometheus.port: 9090
      otel_collector.selfMetricsPort: 9090
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'selfMetricsPort.*must differ from otel_collector.prometheus.port'

  - it: rejects an ephemeral-storage limit below queueStorage.sizeLimit by a fraction of an MiB
    set:
      otel_collector.queueStorage.enabled: true
      otel_collector.queueStorage.maxSizeBytes: 1048576
      otel_collector.queueStorage.sizeLimit: 1536.9Mi
      otel_collector.queueStorage.ephemeralStorageLimit: 1536.1Mi
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ephemeral-storage limit must be at least otel_collector.queueStorage.sizeLimit'

  - it: rejects a volume smaller than the database and compaction budget
    set:
      otel_collector.queueStorage.enabled: true
      otel_collector.queueStorage.sizeLimit: 1Gi
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'must allow at least 6x maxSizeBytes'

  - it: rejects a container disk limit smaller than the queue volume
    set:
      otel_collector.queueStorage.enabled: true
      logfire-otel-collector.resources.limits.ephemeral-storage: 1Gi
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'ephemeral-storage limit must be at least otel_collector.queueStorage.sizeLimit'

  - it: rejects an enlarged byte queue without database headroom
    set:
      otel_collector.queueStorage.enabled: true
      otel_collector.exporter.sending_queue.queue_size: 268435456
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'must allow at least 4x the effective byte queue_size'

  - it: uses the effective preset queue for database validation
    set:
      sizingPreset: standard
      otel_collector.queueStorage.enabled: true
      otel_collector.queueStorage.maxSizeBytes: 268435456
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate:
          errorPattern: 'must allow at least 4x the effective byte queue_size'

  - it: accepts an enlarged queue when all disk budgets are raised
    set:
      otel_collector.queueStorage.enabled: true
      otel_collector.queueStorage.maxSizeBytes: 1073741824
      otel_collector.queueStorage.sizeLimit: 8Gi
      otel_collector.queueStorage.ephemeralStorageLimit: 9Gi
      otel_collector.exporter.sending_queue.queue_size: 268435456
    template: templates/logfire-otel-collector-cfg.yaml
    asserts:
      - matchRegex:
          path: data["otel-collector-config.yaml"]
          pattern: 'queue_size: 268435456'
      - matchRegex:
          path: data["otel-collector-config.yaml"]
          pattern: 'max_size: 1073741824'

  - it: does not compare item counts with byte database limits
    set:
      otel_collector.queueStorage.enabled: true
      otel_collector.exporter.sending_queue.sizer: items
      otel_collector.exporter.sending_queue.queue_size: 268435456
    template: templates/logfire-otel-collector-cfg.yaml
    asserts:
      - matchRegex:
          path: data["otel-collector-config.yaml"]
          pattern: 'sizer: items'

  - it: accepts signed and decimal memory quantities
    set:
      otel_collector.prometheus.enabled: true
      logfire-otel-collector.resources.limits.memory: "+1Gi"
    template: templates/logfire-otel-collector-cfg.yaml
    asserts:
      - matchRegex:
          path: data["otel-collector-config.yaml"]
          pattern: 'limit_percentage: 75'

name: Test Chart

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  suites:
    name: ${{ matrix.suite }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest-16-cores
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        suite: [chart-testing, stable-upgrade]
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    env:
      CT_TARGET_BRANCH: ${{ github.base_ref || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check release notes updates
        if: matrix.suite == 'chart-testing'
        run: node ci/check-release-notes.cjs

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@v4
        with:
          # v4.2.1 hangs during kind/local-path uninstall waits in chart-testing.
          version: v4.2.0

      - name: Install helm-unittest plugin
        if: matrix.suite == 'chart-testing'
        run: helm plugin install https://github.com/helm-unittest/helm-unittest --version v1.1.1 --verify=false

      - name: Run helm unittest
        if: matrix.suite == 'chart-testing'
        run: helm unittest charts/logfire

      - name: Set up python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
          check-latest: true

      - name: Set up chart-testing
        if: matrix.suite == 'chart-testing'
        uses: helm/chart-testing-action@v2.8.0

      - name: Chart linting
        if: matrix.suite == 'chart-testing'
        run: ct lint --config ci/ct.yaml --target-branch "$CT_TARGET_BRANCH"

      - name: Build chart dependencies
        run: |
          helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
          helm repo add jetstack https://charts.jetstack.io
          helm dependency build charts/logfire

      - name: Check configuration rendering
        if: matrix.suite == 'chart-testing'
        run: ci/check-version-stable-checksums.sh

      - name: Set up GCP auth
        id: auth
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ secrets.WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ secrets.SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
          token_format: 'access_token'
          access_token_lifetime: 3600s

      - name: Generate pull secret
        env:
          DOCKER_CONFIG: "."
          REPOSITORY: "us-docker.pkg.dev"
        run: |
          echo "::add-mask::${{ steps.auth.outputs.access_token }}"
          cat <<EOF >"${DOCKER_CONFIG}/config.json"
          {
           "auths": { "${REPOSITORY}": {} }
          }
          EOF
          echo "${{ steps.auth.outputs.access_token }}" | docker login -u oauth2accesstoken --password-stdin "${REPOSITORY}"

      - name: Create Kind Cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@v1
        with:
          config: 'ci/kind.yaml'

      - name: Verify image pull concurrency
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node=$(kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          kubectl get --raw "/api/v1/nodes/$node/proxy/configz" \
            | jq -e '.kubeletconfig | {serializeImagePulls, maxParallelImagePulls}
              | select(.serializeImagePulls == false and .maxParallelImagePulls == 4)'

      - name: Create the restricted namespace
        run: |
          kubectl create namespace logfire-restricted
          # Relaxed while the bundled Redis is still un-hardened. Enforce baseline and report
          # restricted violations as warnings, so the install is not rejected. Restore
          # `pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted` once the Redis hardening lands.
          kubectl label namespace logfire-restricted pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=baseline pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn=restricted

      - name: Create k8s secrets
        run: |
          for ns in default logfire-restricted; do
            kubectl create secret generic pg-dsns -n "$ns" \
              --from-literal="postgresDsn=postgres://postgres:postgres@logfire-postgres:5432/crud" \
              --from-literal="postgresFFDsn=postgres://postgres:postgres@logfire-postgres:5432/ff" \

            kubectl create secret generic logfire-tokens -n "$ns" \
              --from-literal="logfire-dex-client-secret=$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)" \
              --from-literal="logfire-meta-write-token=$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)" \
              --from-literal="logfire-meta-frontend-token=$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)" \
              --from-literal="logfire-jwt-secret=$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)" \
              --from-literal="logfire-unsubscribe-secret=$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)" \
              --from-literal="logfire-encryption-key=$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '\n')" \
              --from-literal="logfire-mcp-oauth-client-secret=$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)"

            kubectl create secret generic logfire-admin -n "$ns" \
              --from-literal="logfire-admin-password=$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)" \
              --from-literal="logfire-admin-totp-secret=$(head -c 20 /dev/urandom | base32 | tr -d '=' | head -c 32)" \
              --from-literal="logfire-admin-totp-recovery-codes=[\"$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)\"]" \
              --from-literal="logfire-jwt-secret=$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)"

            kubectl create secret generic logfire-gateway -n "$ns" \
              --from-literal="key=$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '\n')" \
              --from-literal="internalSecret=$(date +%s%N | sha256sum | head -c 32)"
          done

      - name: Run chart testing
        if: matrix.suite == 'chart-testing'
        run: |
          chart_args=()
          if ! git diff --quiet "origin/$CT_TARGET_BRANCH...HEAD" -- .github/workflows/pr.yaml ci/ct.yaml ci/kind.yaml; then
            chart_args=(--charts charts/logfire)
          fi
          ct install --upgrade --config ci/ct.yaml --target-branch "$CT_TARGET_BRANCH" "${chart_args[@]}"

      - name: Install uv
        if: matrix.suite == 'stable-upgrade'
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5

      - name: Test stable upgrade, release contracts, and split query topology
        if: matrix.suite == 'stable-upgrade'
        env:
          LOGFIRE_TEST_NAMESPACE: logfire-restricted
        run: ci/run-kind-tests.sh

  test:
    needs: suites
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Require both suites to pass
        env:
          SUITES_RESULT: ${{ needs.suites.result }}
        run: test "$SUITES_RESULT" = success

kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
kubeadmConfigPatches:
- |
  kind: KubeletConfiguration
  serializeImagePulls: false
  maxParallelImagePulls: 4
nodes:
- role: control-plane
  extraMounts:
  - containerPath: /var/lib/kubelet/config.json
    hostPath: ./config.json

remote: origin
target-branch: main
chart-dirs:
  - charts
namespace: default
release-label: "app.kubernetes.io/instance"
validate-maintainers: false
debug: false
check-version-increment: true
helm-extra-args: "--timeout 600s"
print-logs: false
chart-repos:
  - bitnami=https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
  - jetstack=https://charts.jetstack.io

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# PyYAML is available in chart-testing's Python environment.

repo_root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT

cp -R "$repo_root/charts/logfire" "$tmp_dir/base"
cp -R "$tmp_dir/base" "$tmp_dir/version-change"

sed -i.bak 's/^version:.*/version: 999.999.999/' "$tmp_dir/version-change/Chart.yaml"
rm "$tmp_dir/version-change/Chart.yaml.bak"

render() {
  local chart=$1
  shift
  helm template checksum-test "$chart" \
    --set-string adminEmail=test@example.com \
    --set-string objectStore.uri=s3://test-bucket \
    --set existingSecret.enabled=true \
    --set-string existingSecret.name=logfire-secrets \
    --set postgresSecret.enabled=true \
    --set-string postgresSecret.name=postgres-secrets \
    "$@"
}

checksums() {
  # Every checksum family a value change must move. Keep the list complete.
  awk '/checksum\/(config|ff-config|service-config|logfire-redis-dsns):/ { print }' | sort
}

render "$tmp_dir/base" >"$tmp_dir/base.yaml"
render "$tmp_dir/version-change" >"$tmp_dir/version-change.yaml"
checksums <"$tmp_dir/base.yaml" >"$tmp_dir/base-checksums"
checksums <"$tmp_dir/version-change.yaml" >"$tmp_dir/version-checksums"

if [[ ! -s "$tmp_dir/base-checksums" ]]; then
  echo "No configuration checksum annotations were rendered" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! diff -u "$tmp_dir/base-checksums" "$tmp_dir/version-checksums"; then
  echo "A chart-version-only change altered workload configuration checksums" >&2
  exit 1
fi

render "$tmp_dir/base" --set-string redisDsn=redis://changed:6379 | checksums >"$tmp_dir/config-change-checksums"

if cmp -s "$tmp_dir/base-checksums" "$tmp_dir/config-change-checksums"; then
  echo "A configuration change did not alter workload configuration checksums" >&2
  exit 1
fi

render "$tmp_dir/base" --set-string 'otel_collector.exporter.headers.helm\.sh/chart=before' | checksums >"$tmp_dir/header-before-checksums"
render "$tmp_dir/base" --set-string 'otel_collector.exporter.headers.helm\.sh/chart=after' | checksums >"$tmp_dir/header-after-checksums"

if cmp -s "$tmp_dir/header-before-checksums" "$tmp_dir/header-after-checksums"; then
  echo "A user configuration key named helm.sh/chart was excluded from workload configuration checksums" >&2
  exit 1
fi

for chart in base version-change; do
  render "$tmp_dir/$chart" \
    --set-json 'logfire-dex.config.staticClients=[{"id":"test-client","name":"Test","secret":"test","redirectURIs":["https://client.example.com/callback"]}]' \
    --set-json 'logfire-dex.config.connectors=[{"id":"test","type":"oidc","name":"Test","config":{"issuer":"https://idp.example.com"}}]' \
    >"$tmp_dir/$chart-custom.yaml"
done

python3 - "$tmp_dir" <<'PY'
import base64
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import yaml

for custom in (False, True):
    snapshots = []
    for chart in ("base", "version-change"):
        name = chart + ("-custom" if custom else "")
        resources = {}
        for raw in (Path(sys.argv[1]) / f"{name}.yaml").read_text().split("\n---\n"):
            resource = yaml.safe_load(raw)
            if resource:
                resources[resource["kind"], resource["metadata"]["name"]] = resource, raw
        deployment, _ = resources["Deployment", "logfire-dex"]
        pod = deployment["spec"]["template"]
        secret_name = next(volume["secret"]["secretName"] for volume in pod["spec"]["volumes"] if volume["name"] == "config")
        secret, raw = resources["Secret", secret_name]
        encoded = secret["data"]["config.yaml"]
        config = yaml.safe_load(base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True))
        assert isinstance(config, dict) and config, f"{name}: Dex config is empty or invalid"
        backend, _ = resources["Deployment", "logfire-backend"]
        backend_client = next(env["value"] for env in backend["spec"]["template"]["spec"]["containers"][0]["env"] if env["name"] == "DEX_CLIENT_ID")
        assert backend_client, f"{name}: Backend Dex client ID is empty"
        assert [client["id"] for client in config["staticClients"]] == [backend_client] + (["test-client"] if custom else []), f"{name}: Dex clients were lost or duplicated"
        assert [connector["id"] for connector in config["connectors"]] == (["test"] if custom else []), f"{name}: Dex connectors were lost or duplicated"
        if custom:
            assert config["connectors"][0]["config"]["issuer"] == "https://idp.example.com"
        normalized = "\n".join(line for line in raw.rstrip("\n").splitlines() if not line.startswith(("# Source:", "---", "    helm.sh/chart:"))) + "\n"
        checksum = pod["metadata"]["annotations"]["checksum/config"]
        assert checksum == hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode()).hexdigest(), f"{name}: Dex checksum does not match its rendered Secret"
        snapshots.append((encoded, checksum))
    assert snapshots[0] == snapshots[1], "A chart-version-only change altered Dex configuration"
    if custom:
        assert snapshots[0][0] != default_snapshot[0], "Custom Dex settings did not change its configuration"
        assert snapshots[0][1] != default_snapshot[1], "Custom Dex settings did not change its checksum"
    else:
        default_snapshot = snapshots[0]
    print(f"PASS real Dex Secret, checksum, and version stability: {'custom' if custom else 'default'}")
PY
